assumptions.dispatchPolicy: FIFO waiting queue; lowest OSRM Table ETA; vehicle ID tie-break; full-route confirmation
assumptions.maxWaitDefinition: Actual predicted pickup minus request <= maxWaitSeconds (inclusive)
assumptions.invalidBookingPolicy: No replacement geometry; unserved at deadline with failureReason
assumptions.travelModel: Constant distance progress over OSRM estimated duration; no dwell/traffic/GPS
assumptions.stationaryPickup: pickupRoute=null only when car is already at snapped pickup (<0.1 m)
assumptions.compatibleVehicles: Exact requested service type only; no automatic substitution
assumptions.serviceOutage: Preparation fails explicitly; no partial/fabricated plan returned

assumptions.vehicleClass: electric motorcycle 70 km/h design, assumed 6 kW; not moped
assumptions.eta: OSRM static model-based estimates, not measured GSM traffic
assumptions.voucher: No multimodal choice or voucher behavior in this contract
